htn_kidney.title: Finerenone in hypertensive non-diabetic chronic kidney disease: a FIND-CKD subgroup analysis.
htn_kidney.authors: Heerspink HJL, Beernink JM, Agarwal R

htn_kidney.abstract: Hypertension is a common attributable cause of chronic kidney disease (CKD). Mineralocorticoid receptor overactivation can lead to hypertension and contributes to CKD progression. In FIND-CKD, finerenone reduced kidney function decline in participants with CKD without diabetes. This prespecified FIND-CKD analysis assessed finerenone efficacy and safety in participants with hypertensive nephropathy. Adults with estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) 25-<90 mL/min/1.73 m2 and urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) 200-3500 mg/g were randomized 1:1 to once-daily finerenone or placebo.
